title: Follow a real proof into a CashVM-authorized spend
establishes: the released transition proof verifies under the pinned BN254 wrapper key
the proof-bound public statement and reconstructed transaction derive the same settlement projection
a synthetic terminal-verdict token carrying that projection lets the released SAC authorize the transaction in Libauth CashVM
five isolated tamper controls reject at the proof, public-fixture, verdict, transaction-projection, and P2SH32 boundaries
doesNotEstablish: that this lab executes the production authenticated-verifier graph or produces its terminal verdict token
funding, signing, relay, mining, chain inclusion, wallet acceptance, custody, spendability, or production privacy
